Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4017441. Return rows sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
